title: Mildred, 67
body: Gas station sushi critic. 847 stations reviewed. If you can't handle me at my Flying J, you don't deserve me at my Pilot. Looking for a co-pilot for this beautiful journey. Must appreciate the subtle art of truck stop cuisine.
summary: Gas station sushi critic. 847 stations reviewed. Looking for a co-pilot.

prompts.question: My ideal first date involves...
prompts.answer: A romantic gas station sushi tasting along Interstate 84. I know all the best spots. Bring antacids (for you, not me - I'm immune).

prompts.question: Green flags I look for...
prompts.answer: Someone who doesn't judge sushi by its location. Also someone with their own rewards card at multiple gas station chains.

prompts.question: My simple pleasures...
prompts.answer: The crinkle of a gas station sushi container at 2 AM. The fluorescent lights. The judgmental stares from other customers. Heaven.
